Name: Item Bags for Lumisteria's Mods
Author: spritelessG
Description:
I like mods that add items, but I don't like inventory management that much. Or, rather, I would like for inventory management to be something I can win hehe. <(^__^)> So, I have made some item bags to help with that.

The Serene Meadow bag contains all items in Serene Meadow. If Lumisteria adds more items to that mod, the bag will automagically add the new slots.

The Mount Vapious bags will not though. I thought it would be fun to hide some rare items in more expensive bags. The mod has some... surprises... that I didn't want to spoil. (>_>)

Downloads.Description: I forgot a few items last version, These bags include them.
